notes: POEDBToken implements poedb (POEDB) as an ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers move exact amounts without fees. The token has no administrative roles, external mint or burn functions, or upgrade mechanism. Project reference: https://poedb.tw/us/. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
